corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez scripture text on Col 1 Line 1 clearly reads 'ለልሳኑ' (with preposition ለ- and 2nd order ኑ), matching the parallel construction 'ለልቡ' in Line 4.
Visually, the initial character has the distinct top crossbar and three vertical legs with the 6th-order hook of 'ሕ' (ሕብቃቁ, meaning 'spot/blemish' in Ge'ez James 1:27), which was misread as 'አ'.
